registryAssessment: The Rosreestr Public Cadastral Map was migrated to the national NSDI platform; the Yaroslavl regional administration’s Rosreestr page identifies the territorial registry authority for Yaroslavl Oblast. The public map supports parcel reference lookup, but no anonymous geometry response was directly verified in this review.
